title: Cloud toolchain target — Buck2 build/test authority + Prow/Kubernetes-native oya-ci + GitHub adapters
purpose: Consolidated target for the build + CI/CD + verify toolchain overhaul. Buck2 is the build/test/check authority for active lanes; Cargo metadata can feed generated Buck2 graphs and local Cargo mutation output remains advisory in a deliberate dual-build setup. CI authority is the Rust, Prow-shaped, Kubernetes-native oya-ci controller posting source-bound oya-ci-required from trusted controller state. GitHub remains a PR/publication adapter and GitHub Actions remains compatibility/shadow evidence, not the permanent destination. Honest non-claim: target spec; no full native controller parity, remote execution/cache, release conveyor, or live production cutover is claimed here.

build_graph.system: Buck2 rust rules and checked-in BUCK targets are canonical for CI/build/test/check lanes.
build_graph.dependency_ssot: Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock may remain the Rust dependency metadata source for reindeer-style Buck2 graph generation; generated BUCK output is reviewed and Buck2 remains authority.
build_graph.remote: remote build execution + hermetic remote cache are native-toolchain targets; the bridge must not require a non-native external CI/CD substrate.
build_graph.affected_targets: Buck2 owner/reverse-dependency affected-target selection for presubmit; avoid full-workspace rebuild on small changes except at serialized fan-in gates.
build_graph.incremental: no incremental compilation in CI (from-scratch + remote cache); incremental local only

ci.orchestrator: ADR-0513 Rust/Prow/Kubernetes-native oya-ci is the active CI authority direction; ADR-0516 GitHub Actions remains compatibility/shadow evidence while native SCM/publication adapters mature.
ci.config: ProwJob-style registry and Rust/Buck2-generated consolidation are the target; GitHub Actions workflows stay pointer-thin compatibility/shadow artifacts only. Native jobs use short-lived workload identity, tightly scoped secrets, isolated pipelines, and Kubernetes-native elastic agents.
ci.pr_gating: Merge readiness targets source-bound oya-ci-required from the trusted oya-ci controller; github-lane-unlocker-required is legacy/shadow compatibility and cannot satisfy durable native authority.
ci.test_runner: Buck2 test targets and Buck2-native LLVM source-based coverage are merge authority; Cargo/nextest may remain local advisory only where the dual-build strategy is intentionally maintained.
ci.local_dev: Buck2 affected/full targets for shift-left; Cargo commands are advisory and must not become protected-branch authority.

oya_overlay.role: governance kernels/checks as Rust libraries, Buck2 targets, and Prow/Kubernetes-native jobs; the oya CLI is not merge or CI authority.
oya_overlay.retires: duplicated Cargo mirror authority, oya gate/verify CLI authority, and manual required-status bridges; affected-scope default plus serialized fan-in evidence.

merge_and_delivery.merge_queue: native SCM virtual heads plus Tide-like speculative/batch merge queue; GitHub PR queue is an adapter/shadow until native SCM is live.
merge_and_delivery.progressive_delivery: release-conveyor-like native CD target: canary -> bake-time SLO observation -> automatic metric-gated rollback; cosign-verified images (ADR-0181).

non_claims: Target spec only; no full native SCM/CI/CD cutover, remote execution/cache, release conveyor, or migration executed.
GitHub is a PR/publication adapter and GitHub Actions is compatibility/shadow evidence only; neither is durable first-class CI authority.
No CI-throughput/cache-hit/SLO measurement; all parity/performance claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.

native_scm_ci_cd_fit.scm: Sapling-inspired pure-Rust native SCM service/control-plane; no oya vcs CLI revival. Owns stacked changes, workspace leases, virtual merge heads, semantic conflict metadata, and GitHub publication adapters.
native_scm_ci_cd_fit.ci: Prow/Kubernetes-native oya-ci consumes trusted SCM/controller state, runs Buck2 workloads, and posts source-bound oya-ci-required.
native_scm_ci_cd_fit.cd: release-conveyor-like native CD consumes signed build/evidence/release ledger outputs from oya-ci for progressive delivery, rollback, and audit.
native_scm_ci_cd_fit.github: PR/publication adapter; GitHub Actions is shadow compatibility only.
